title: Cavity Over Temperature
shortDescription: Oven cavity exceeded its safe upper limit.
fullDescription: TurboChef high-speed ovens (Sota, Encore, i5, Tornado) lock out with E10 when the cavity temperature exceeds the safety threshold. Causes include stuck contactor, runaway heater, fan failure, or thermocouple/RTD problems.

fixSteps.title: Isolate power
fixSteps.instruction: Turn off oven and disconnect power before service.

fixSteps.title: Inspect contactor
fixSteps.instruction: Check for welded contacts; replace contactor if found.

fixSteps.title: Test thermocouple
fixSteps.instruction: Verify thermocouple/RTD reading at known temp.

whenToCallPro: Stuck contactors and high-voltage work justify a tech visit.

faq.a: No. Stop use until E10 is diagnosed; runaway heating is a fire risk.

title: Cavity Temperature Sensor Open
shortDescription: Cavity thermocouple reading is open or out of range.
fullDescription: E11 means the controller is not receiving a valid signal from the cavity sensor. This is a safety lockout that prevents heating without temperature feedback.

fixSteps.title: Check connector
fixSteps.instruction: Inspect thermocouple connector at the controller.

fixSteps.title: Replace thermocouple
fixSteps.instruction: Install new TurboChef-spec thermocouple if open.

whenToCallPro: If thermocouple reads correctly, the control board may be at fault.

faq.a: Yes, by design until valid temperature feedback is restored.

title: Convection Blower Fault
shortDescription: Blower not running or feedback invalid.
fullDescription: TurboChef relies on impingement air flow for fast cooking. E20 fires when the blower motor stalls or feedback is missing. Operating without airflow can ruin food and overheat components.

fixSteps.title: Clean intake filter
fixSteps.instruction: Remove grease-laden air filter and clean or replace.

fixSteps.title: Inspect blower
fixSteps.instruction: Check for free rotation and debris. Listen for bearing noise.

whenToCallPro: Motor or VFD replacement requires service.

faq.a: Grease clogs the filter and impellers, raising motor load.

title: Cooling Fan Fault
fullDescription: TurboChef ovens use cooling fans to protect the magnetron, control board, and inverter. E21 sets when one of those fans fails to run, risking thermal damage.

fixSteps.title: Replace fan
fixSteps.instruction: Install new cooling fan if not running.

faq.a: Behind the rear access panel; consult parts diagram.

title: Magnetron / Microwave Fault
fullDescription: TurboChef high-speed ovens combine impingement and microwave. E30 indicates a microwave generator fault: failed magnetron, inverter, or interlock anomaly. High-voltage work; do not service without training.

fixSteps.title: Verify door interlocks
fixSteps.instruction: Check that all interlock switches close fully when door shuts.

fixSteps.title: Service call
fixSteps.instruction: Have certified tech discharge HV cap and test magnetron and inverter.

whenToCallPro: High voltage capacitors store lethal charge; only trained techs should service.

faq.a: It will operate as convection-only at best; full performance requires repair.

title: Door Switch / Interlock Error
fullDescription: Multiple interlock switches must agree on door position. If they disagree, E31 fires for safety. Microwave systems are interlocked to prevent leakage.

fixSteps.title: Check alignment
fixSteps.instruction: Adjust door to fully engage all switches.

fixSteps.title: Test switches
fixSteps.instruction: Use multimeter to verify each switch operates with door close.

whenToCallPro: Door system is part of microwave safety; have a tech verify after service.

faq.a: Redundant interlocks ensure microwave cannot run with door ajar.

title: Catalytic Converter Over Temp
fullDescription: Some TurboChef models include catalytic converters in the exhaust. E40 indicates the catalyst is overheating, often from grease ignition or runaway heating.

fixSteps.title: Cool down and clean
fixSteps.instruction: Allow full cooldown, then remove and clean catalyst per manual.

whenToCallPro: If runaway is the cause, refer to a tech.

faq.a: Heavily fouled catalysts may need replacement per service bulletin.

title: Heater Element Open
fullDescription: E50 detects an open heating element. Without primary heat the oven cannot reach setpoint and locks out.

fixSteps.title: Test element
fixSteps.instruction: Power off, measure resistance across element terminals; replace if open.

whenToCallPro: Element replacement involves disassembly and high voltage; consider tech.

faq.a: Thermal cycling and grease ignition shorten life.

title: Communication Error
fullDescription: E60 indicates the control board lost communication with a peripheral controller (display, VFD, etc). Cabling, connectors, or boards are likely culprits.

fixSteps.title: Reseat cables
fixSteps.instruction: Reseat all controller harnesses and ribbon cables.

whenToCallPro: Board replacement requires firmware setup by a technician.

faq.a: Yes, recommended for commercial control electronics.

title: Voltage Out of Range
shortDescription: Supply voltage too high or too low.
fullDescription: E70 fires when the supply voltage falls outside the safe range. Continued operation could damage motors, inverters, and electronics. Often a building wiring or panel issue.

fixSteps.title: Measure supply
fixSteps.instruction: Verify voltage between phases and to neutral within nameplate range.

fixSteps.title: Tighten connections
fixSteps.instruction: Power off panel, torque terminal lugs to spec.

whenToCallPro: Building wiring should be assessed by a licensed electrician.

faq.a: Yes; brownouts when fryers and dishwashers cycle indicate undersized circuits.

title: Top Heater Open
fullDescription: TurboChef rapid-cook ovens monitor each heating circuit. E01 indicates the top sheath heater or its safety thermostat is open.

fixSteps.title: Inspect terminals
fixSteps.instruction: Check terminals at heater for discoloration.

fixSteps.title: Replace heater
fixSteps.instruction: Swap top heater assembly per service manual.

whenToCallPro: TurboChef magnetron and HV components are dangerous; use a TurboChef-trained tech. Commercial appliance work in foodservice settings requires a licensed/EPA-certified technician for refrigerant, gas, or high-voltage components.

faq.q: Can I clear and keep cooking?
faq.a: Only after the underlying fault is corrected; running with active errors may damage the magnetron.

title: Bottom Heater Open
fullDescription: Same logic as E01 but for the bottom heater. Common on high-volume units used for pizza or sandwiches.
whenToCallPro: TurboChef magnetron and HV components are dangerous; use a TurboChef-trained tech. Commercial appliance work in foodservice settings requires a licensed/EPA-certified technician for refrigerant, gas, or high-voltage components.

faq.q: Can I clear and keep cooking?
faq.a: Only after the underlying fault is corrected; running with active errors may damage the magnetron.

title: Magnetron Fault
fullDescription: TurboChef pairs convection with microwave energy. E03 indicates the magnetron or HV transformer failed self-test.

fixSteps.title: Discharge HV cap
fixSteps.instruction: Always discharge HV capacitor before service.

fixSteps.title: Test HV components
fixSteps.instruction: Use proper HV-rated equipment to test.

fixSteps.title: Replace magnetron
fixSteps.instruction: Swap magnetron assembly with OEM part.

whenToCallPro: TurboChef magnetron and HV components are dangerous; use a TurboChef-trained tech. Commercial appliance work in foodservice settings requires a licensed/EPA-certified technician for refrigerant, gas, or high-voltage components.

faq.q: Can I clear and keep cooking?
faq.a: Only after the underlying fault is corrected; running with active errors may damage the magnetron.

title: Blower Motor Stalled
fullDescription: Blower feedback below threshold trips E04. Causes include bearing failure, debris in fan, or VFD/motor issue.

fixSteps.title: Inspect impeller
fixSteps.instruction: Remove panel and rotate impeller; remove debris.

whenToCallPro: TurboChef magnetron and HV components are dangerous; use a TurboChef-trained tech. Commercial appliance work in foodservice settings requires a licensed/EPA-certified technician for refrigerant, gas, or high-voltage components.

faq.q: Can I clear and keep cooking?
faq.a: Only after the underlying fault is corrected; running with active errors may damage the magnetron.

title: Cavity Thermocouple Open
fullDescription: TurboChef uses K-type thermocouples in the cavity. E05 means the controller cannot read a valid signal.

fixSteps.title: Reseat thermocouple
fixSteps.instruction: Check polarity and torque at terminals.

fixSteps.title: Replace control board
fixSteps.instruction: If signal still missing, replace board.

whenToCallPro: TurboChef magnetron and HV components are dangerous; use a TurboChef-trained tech. Commercial appliance work in foodservice settings requires a licensed/EPA-certified technician for refrigerant, gas, or high-voltage components.

faq.q: Can I clear and keep cooking?
faq.a: Only after the underlying fault is corrected; running with active errors may damage the magnetron.

title: Cavity Overtemp
fullDescription: E06 trips when cavity temp exceeds set point + offset for too long, often due to stuck contactor or failed sensor.
whenToCallPro: TurboChef magnetron and HV components are dangerous; use a TurboChef-trained tech. Commercial appliance work in foodservice settings requires a licensed/EPA-certified technician for refrigerant, gas, or high-voltage components.

faq.q: Can I clear and keep cooking?
faq.a: Only after the underlying fault is corrected; running with active errors may damage the magnetron.

title: Door Switch Fault
shortDescription: Door interlock not seeing closed door.
fullDescription: Three door switches must agree. E07 indicates a disagreement, common with worn switches or door alignment.

fixSteps.title: Test switches
fixSteps.instruction: Cycle door, verify all three switches change state.

fixSteps.title: Replace switches
fixSteps.instruction: Replace as a set if any fail.

whenToCallPro: TurboChef magnetron and HV components are dangerous; use a TurboChef-trained tech. Commercial appliance work in foodservice settings requires a licensed/EPA-certified technician for refrigerant, gas, or high-voltage components.

faq.a: Door interlock not seeing closed door.

faq.q: Can I clear and keep cooking?
faq.a: Only after the underlying fault is corrected; running with active errors may damage the magnetron.

title: Cooling Fan Failure
shortDescription: PCB or magnetron cooling fan not running.
fullDescription: E08 protects the magnetron and electronics from overheat. Trips when cooling fan tach signal is missing.

fixSteps.title: Inspect fan
fixSteps.instruction: Verify fan spins freely and quietly.

fixSteps.title: Test voltage
fixSteps.instruction: Confirm DC voltage at fan during run.

whenToCallPro: TurboChef magnetron and HV components are dangerous; use a TurboChef-trained tech. Commercial appliance work in foodservice settings requires a licensed/EPA-certified technician for refrigerant, gas, or high-voltage components.

faq.a: PCB or magnetron cooling fan not running.

faq.q: Can I clear and keep cooking?
faq.a: Only after the underlying fault is corrected; running with active errors may damage the magnetron.

title: Catalytic Converter Overtemp
fullDescription: TurboChef ovens with catalytic converters protect them from overheat. E09 trips when converter sensor exceeds limit.
whenToCallPro: TurboChef magnetron and HV components are dangerous; use a TurboChef-trained tech. Commercial appliance work in foodservice settings requires a licensed/EPA-certified technician for refrigerant, gas, or high-voltage components.

faq.q: Can I clear and keep cooking?
faq.a: Only after the underlying fault is corrected; running with active errors may damage the magnetron.

title: Air Probe Drift
shortDescription: Cavity air probe drifted out of calibration window.
fullDescription: TurboChef compares cavity probe readings against expected slope. E80 advisory is posted when drift exceeds spec, indicating the probe is aging.

fixSteps.title: Calibrate
fixSteps.instruction: Use boiling water reference to verify probe.

whenToCallPro: TurboChef sealed components require trained service. Commercial appliance work in foodservice settings requires a licensed/EPA-certified technician for refrigerant, gas, or high-voltage components.

faq.a: Cavity probe drifted out of calibration window.
Yes briefly, but recalibrate or replace soon to maintain product consistency.
